BALUCHISTAN WORKERS' CHILDREN (EDUCATION) CESS RULES, 1973
BALUCHISTAN WORKERS' CHILDREN (EDUCATION) CESS RULES, 1973
No. 1‑53/73‑Labour,
18 Sept. 1973. Rules framed by the Govern ment of Baluchistan in exercise of
the powers conferred by Section 6 of the Workers' Children (Education)
Ordinance, 1972 (Ordinance No. XI of 1972)‑‑‑Baluchistan
Gazette No. 71, Dec. 28, 1973, p. 1].
1. Short title and commencement.‑---- (i) These rules may be
called the Baluchistan, Workers' Children (Education) Cess Rules, 1973.
(ii) They shall, come into force
at once.
2. Definitions---In these rules, unless the context otherwise
requires the following expressions shall have the, meanings hereby respectively
assigned to them, that is to say‑
(a) "Cess" means the
Cess payable under Section 3 of the Ordinance,
(b) "Director Labour Welfare"
means the Director Labour Welfare Baluchistan;
(c) "Comptroller" means
the Comptroller of Baluchistan,
(d) "Form" means a.
form appended to these rules, and includes a statement or communication on
plain paper containing the same particulars as are specified in the
corresponding form;
(e) "Ordinance" means
the Workers' Children (Education) Ordi nance, 1972 (Ordinance No. XI of 1972);
(f) "Treasury" means a
Treasury or a sub‑Treasury or a branch of any‑Bank in Baluchistan
authorised to receive payment on behalf of Government.
3. Furnishing of Cess return,‑---Every employer" liable
to pay robe Cess shall, before the close of each quarter, furnish to the
Director Labour Welfare a return in form "A" in accordance with the
provisions contained in the Industrial Statistics Act, 1942. a very such return
shall indicate the number of workers employed in his establishment during the
proceeding quarter and shall subscribe a declaration of the truth of the return
at the foot thereof.
4. Maintenance of Register of Establishment. The Director Labour
Welfare shall maintain a register of establishments assessed to Cess in form
'B'.
5. Mode of paying Cess.‑---The Cess payable shall be paid in
a branch of the State Bank of Pakistan, or in a Treasury and a copy of the Bank
or Treasury Challan, as the case may be, shall be furnished to the Director
Labour Welfare.
6. Calculation of Cess.‑--The number of workers on the basis
of which Cess will be calculated will be the highest number attained at any
time during the quarter.
7. Maintenance of accounts by Comptroller.‑---The Comptroller
shall maintain an account Head of Receipts and Expenditure of the Cess.
